title: progress_p1_test.dart E2E-806 claims to verify the documented R-PG7 cross-profile access-control gap but never passes a differing profileId
rule: TQ-8 (assertions weaker than what the source can do wrong / tautological test)

evidence.quote: // profileId here (the tutor sub-test below checks the profileId path

why: The group's own docstring (progress_p1_test.dart:21-22) and R-PG7 registry entry (docs/planning/e2e-test-suite-plan.md:811) both say this journey should 'assert any auth user can load [another profile's data]', but the single test in the group navigates to '/journey' with no profileId query param at all — it loads the caller's own default profile. The comment references 'the tutor sub-test below' that does not exist anywhere in this file. As written the test provides zero signal on R-PG7 in either direction: if the access-control gap is ever fixed, this test won't notice; if it worsens, this test won't notice either.
recommendation: Add the missing sub-test: seed two profiles, request SiyumimMilestonesRoute/journey data for the NON-active profile's id, and assert the returned milestones belong to that other profile — or correct the docstring/comment to stop claiming this scenario is covered here.
acceptance_criteria: A test in this file seeds >=2 profiles and requests journey data via an explicit profileId different from the active profile's.
The assertion checks profile-specific content (not just absence of an error banner) to prove the cross-profile read actually happened.
